newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt police nab smugglers of rare antiquities.
newsitem.headline: Egypt police nab smugglers of rare antiquities.

text.p: Egyptian police foiled an attempt to smuggle to Switzerland a cache of 3,000-year-old antiquities which included the head of a statue of Pharaoh Ahmose and a rare collection of glassware, Cairo airport sources said on Monday.
They said the smugglers, led by an American man, had tried to disguise the 210 kg (464 lb) antiquities shipment as the personal effects of an American diplomat working in Cairo.
Police were tipped off that the parcels were being shipped to Geneva with fake authorisation, the sources added.
Investigations showed that a customs official had faked a letter from the American embassy and that other members of the gang had forged letters from the Egyptian foreign ministry.
